metadata.description: Personal toolkit: strategic-architecture documentation stack, metamodel, and developer workflow — 59 skills in 11 toggleable sets.

plugins.name: agent-loop
plugins.description: Agent-centric development cycle. Guide (agent-config), Verify (grill-me, peer-review), Solve (ralph-loop, issue-loop) — plus the ralph-audit command.

plugins.name: architecture
plugins.description: Architecture. ADRs, research notes, service/CLI contracts, Structurizr/C4, PlantUML/UML, and arc42 narrative.

plugins.name: delivery-comms
plugins.description: Delivery communication. HTML slide decks, artefact visualisations, stakeholder release notes, and the design system that themes them.

plugins.name: dev-flow
plugins.description: Developer workflow. Git enforcement stack, conventional commits, PRs, worktrees, release automation, stack guides, onboarding — plus the branch-cleanup-audit command.

plugins.name: docs-hygiene
plugins.description: Docs hygiene. Documentation freshness audit, OKF index/log generation, and the docs lint toolchain.

plugins.name: domain-modeling
plugins.description: Domain-driven design. Bounded contexts, ubiquitous-language glossary, and tactical domain models.

plugins.name: kit-core
plugins.description: Kit core — always enabled. The metamodel keystone skill (spine, YAML type registry, frontmatter schema, open-items contract, Audit/Scaffold/Migrate modes) plus the cross-cutting operators: open-items ledger, provenance, toolkit doctor.

plugins.name: ops
plugins.description: Operations. Runbooks, bug RCAs, and Exoscale Terraform automation.

plugins.name: product-spec
plugins.description: Product specs & planning. FBS, PRDs, use cases, delivery roadmap, and implementation plans.

plugins.name: quality-assurance
plugins.description: Quality assurance & test layer. Quality attributes (ISO/IEC 25010), test strategy (pyramid allocation, QA-XXNN→TS-NN mapping), and test scenarios/cases derived from use-case flows, user stories, and quality attributes.

plugins.name: strategy
plugins.description: Business strategy & discovery. Vision, personas, canvases, capability map, value streams, objectives, processes, quantitative models, competitive landscape — plus discovery ideation, research, and workshops.
